settings-entry-owner.title: Manage Zurich Weekend
settings-entry-owner.lead: Current role and group version are checked before any lifecycle write.
settings-entry-owner.notice: This settings surface cannot settle money, sign, pay, or widen another member’s authority.

settings-entry-member.title: Manage your membership
settings-entry-member.lead: Group-wide settings stay owner-controlled. You can inspect facts and leave when eligible.
settings-entry-member.notice: Being a member never grants owner, payment, wallet, or signing authority.

settings-loading.title: Loading settings
settings-loading.lead: Fresh role and group-version facts are required before writes are shown.
settings-loading.notice: Wait for current facts; cached owner status cannot authorize a change.

settings-offline.title: Saved settings are read-only
settings-offline.lead: You can understand the last saved group facts, but lifecycle writes are unavailable.
settings-offline.notice: Reconnect and refresh role/version truth before changing the group.

settings-load-failed.title: Settings are not current
settings-load-failed.lead: The read failed before any lifecycle action began.
settings-load-failed.notice: Retry only reloads current facts. It does not retry a mutation.

group-unavailable.title: This group is no longer available
group-unavailable.lead: ChopDot will not re-open cached settings after current access is gone.
group-unavailable.notice: Return Home. If this is unexpected, recovery belongs outside this settings screen.

settings-overview-owner.title: Group settings
settings-overview-owner.lead: Change group identity and lifecycle without changing its money history.
facts: Present; archive allowed, delete not yet
settings-overview-owner.notice: Archive is organization state only. Delete, leave and ownership changes have separate safeguards.

settings-overview-member.title: Group settings
settings-overview-member.lead: Owner-controlled settings are visible as context; your own leave flow stays separate.
settings-overview-member.notice: You cannot rename, configure, archive, transfer ownership or delete this group.

permission-changed.title: Your owner action stopped
permission-changed.lead: Fresh group truth says you are now a member, so the stale owner action was not applied.
permission-changed.notice: Permission is checked again before the effect; intent never outranks current authority.

stale-settings.title: Review the latest settings
stale-settings.lead: The group version changed elsewhere, so this screen cannot authorize a stale write.

rename-edit.title: Rename the group
rename-edit.lead: Only the current display name changes. Stable identity and historical facts do not.
rename-edit.notice: The demo draft is deterministic; production text entry is not claimed.

rename-invalid.title: Enter a group name
rename-invalid.lead: An empty or whitespace-only name cannot be reviewed or saved.
rename-invalid.notice: Fix the draft; no lifecycle effect occurred.

rename-review.title: Zurich Weekend → Zurich Long Weekend
rename-review.lead: Confirm the exact display-name change before the first effect.
rename-review.notice: If role or version changes now, this review becomes stale.

rename-saving.title: Saving the group name
rename-saving.lead: The logical rename operation is in flight. Another save is disabled.
rename-saving.notice: Leaving this pending screen means the result must be reconciled before retry.

rename-cancelled.title: Rename cancelled
rename-cancelled.lead: You cancelled before the first effect.
rename-cancelled.notice: Cancelled is a verified no-effect outcome, not a success.

rename-failed.title: The group name is still Zurich Weekend
rename-failed.lead: The service rejected the operation before acceptance.
rename-failed.notice: Because no effect is verified, retrying the same logical operation is safe.

rename-unknown.title: Do not save again yet
rename-unknown.lead: ChopDot cannot currently prove whether REN26-A was accepted.
rename-unknown.notice: Check the exact operation before any new rename effect.

rename-reconciling.title: Reconciling rename
rename-reconciling.lead: The existing operation is checked; no duplicate rename is created.
rename-reconciling.notice: Use observed effect/no-effect truth, not the original intent.

rename-no-effect-retry.title: REN26-A had no effect
rename-no-effect-retry.lead: The exact operation is verified not accepted; the current name remains unchanged.
rename-no-effect-retry.notice: A retry reuses the logical operation instead of creating an unrelated duplicate.

rename-success.title: Group renamed
rename-success.lead: Zurich Long Weekend is now the observed display name.
rename-success.notice: Only display identity changed; no money or membership fact moved.

rename-conflict.title: The name changed elsewhere
rename-conflict.lead: This stale review was not submitted because the observed group version changed.
rename-conflict.notice: Refresh and decide again from current truth.

config-edit.title: Choose a default currency
config-edit.lead: This setting only preselects currency for expenses created after the accepted change.
config-edit.notice: No balance, settlement or historical amount is converted.

config-review.title: CHF → EUR for future expenses
config-review.notice: This is a future-entry default, not a currency migration.

config-saving.title: Saving future default
config-saving.lead: The stable config operation is in flight; duplicate save is disabled.
config-saving.notice: An unknown result must be reconciled before retry.

config-failed.title: CHF is still the future default
config-failed.lead: The exact operation is verified not accepted.
config-failed.notice: Known no-effect means retry is safe.

config-unknown.title: Do not save the default again yet
config-unknown.lead: ChopDot cannot prove whether CFG26-A was accepted.

config-reconciling.title: Reconciling configuration
config-reconciling.lead: No new config write occurs while existing outcome truth is checked.
config-reconciling.notice: Observed state decides the next action.

config-no-effect-retry.title: CFG26-A had no effect
config-no-effect-retry.lead: CHF is observed unchanged and the same logical operation may retry.

config-success.title: Future default is EUR
config-success.lead: New expense entry may now preselect EUR; old records remain exactly as recorded.
config-success.notice: Configuration does not rewrite financial history.

config-stale.title: Review the current default first
config-stale.lead: Another change updated the group/default version before this effect.
config-stale.notice: Refresh before deciding again; never overwrite a newer setting silently.

config-cancelled.title: Default change cancelled
config-cancelled.lead: You cancelled before the first effect.
config-cancelled.notice: No financial or configuration fact changed.

archive-review.title: Retire this group from active use
archive-review.lead: Archive is reversible organization state; it is not settlement or deletion.
archive-review.notice: You can restore the group later. Existing money truth is preserved.

archive-confirm.title: Archive Zurich Weekend?
archive-confirm.lead: One more confirmation separates the impact review from the first effect.
archive-confirm.notice: Archiving does not say everyone is square.

archiving.title: Archiving the group
archiving.lead: The lifecycle operation is in flight; duplicate archive is disabled.
archiving.notice: If the result becomes unknown, reconcile ARC26-A before retry.

archive-cancelled.title: Archive cancelled
archive-cancelled.lead: You cancelled before the archive effect.
archive-cancelled.notice: Cancelled is neutral no-effect truth, not verified success.

archive-failed.title: The group is still active
archive-failed.notice: No effect is verified, so retry can reuse the logical operation.

archive-unknown.title: Active or archived is not known yet
archive-unknown.lead: The UI will not guess the lifecycle status from intent.

archive-reconciling.title: Reconciling archive
archive-reconciling.lead: The existing lifecycle operation is checked with no duplicate write.
archive-reconciling.notice: Observed status decides whether to reuse success or permit retry.

archive-no-effect-retry.title: ARC26-A had no effect
archive-no-effect-retry.lead: The group is observed active and the same logical archive may retry.
archive-no-effect-retry.notice: Nothing was settled, deleted or rewritten.

archived.title: Zurich Weekend is out of the active list
archived.lead: History and outstanding positions remain readable; new expense/invite creation is unavailable in this fixture.
facts: Requires sole member + no open items
archived.notice: Archive is reversible and does not mean settled or deleted.

unarchive-review.title: Make Zurich Weekend active again
unarchive-review.lead: Restoring active status re-enables future group activity without rewriting history.
unarchive-review.notice: This is not a restore-from-backup operation; it is a lifecycle status change.

unarchiving.title: Restoring active status
unarchiving.lead: The unarchive operation is in flight; duplicate status changes are disabled.
unarchiving.notice: Unknown result must be checked before another lifecycle write.

unarchive-unknown.title: Active status is not known yet
unarchive-unknown.lead: ChopDot will not assume the restore worked.

unarchive-reconciling.title: Reconciling active status
unarchive-reconciling.lead: No new unarchive operation occurs while the original result is checked.
unarchive-reconciling.notice: Observed status decides the next safe step.

active-restored.title: Zurich Weekend is active again
active-restored.lead: Active-group status is observed; historical facts remain unchanged.

unarchive-failed.title: The group is still archived
unarchive-failed.lead: UNA26-A is verified to have had no effect.
unarchive-failed.notice: Because no effect is verified, retry is safe.

unarchive-cancelled.title: Restore cancelled
unarchive-cancelled.lead: You cancelled before the unarchive effect.
unarchive-cancelled.notice: The archived group remains exactly as it was.

transfer-review.title: Transfer ownership
transfer-review.lead: Choose an already-active member; roster editing itself remains Manage People.
transfer-review.notice: Transfer changes group ownership only. It does not move money, payment preferences, or account authority.

transfer-confirm.title: Make Jeanine the owner?
transfer-confirm.lead: After verified success you become a regular member of this group.
transfer-confirm.notice: If the result is unknown, owner truth must be reconciled before leaving/deleting.

transfer-saving.title: Changing group ownership
transfer-saving.lead: The stable transfer operation is in flight. No second transfer is allowed.
transfer-saving.notice: Do not act as member or owner based on intent alone.

transfer-failed.title: You are still the owner
transfer-failed.notice: Retry is safe because owner truth is observed unchanged.

transfer-unknown.title: Owner identity must be checked
transfer-unknown.lead: ChopDot cannot prove whether OWN26-A was accepted.

transfer-reconciling.title: Reconciling ownership
transfer-reconciling.lead: No duplicate transfer is created while owner truth is observed.
transfer-reconciling.notice: Use the observed owner state, not the requested state.

transfer-success.title: Jeanine is now the owner
transfer-success.lead: Your role is now member. Balances, history and payment preferences are unchanged.
transfer-success.notice: Owner authority changed only after the accepted result was observed.

transfer-cancelled.title: Ownership transfer cancelled
transfer-cancelled.lead: You cancelled before the transfer effect.

leave-review.title: Check what stays true
leave-review.lead: Leaving removes your future access; it never erases historical attribution or open money facts.
leave-review.notice: If open or unresolved items exist, leave is blocked until their owning journey resolves them.

leave-blocked-open-items.title: Resolve open items first
leave-blocked-open-items.lead: J26 will not clear or forgive an unresolved item to make leaving possible.
leave-blocked-open-items.notice: Resolve the item through its existing owner, then return to current settings truth.

leave-owner-blocked.title: Transfer ownership first
leave-owner-blocked.lead: The current owner cannot disappear without an explicit successor.
leave-owner-blocked.notice: Transfer ownership to an active member, then the new member role can use leave.

leave-confirm.title: Leave Zurich Weekend?
leave-confirm.lead: After verified success this account loses future access to the group.
leave-confirm.notice: This does not delete the group for other members.

leaving.title: Leaving the group
leaving.lead: The stable leave operation is in flight; duplicate leave is disabled.
leaving.notice: If result is unknown, reconcile before showing or hiding group access as fact.

leave-cancelled.title: Leave cancelled
leave-cancelled.lead: You cancelled before the leave effect.
leave-cancelled.notice: Historical and current group access remain unchanged.

leave-failed.title: You are still a member
leave-failed.notice: Retry is safe only because the original operation had no effect.

leave-unknown.title: Group access must be checked
leave-unknown.lead: The UI will not guess whether your membership was removed.
leave-unknown.notice: Reconcile before exposing stale group access or trying to leave again.

leave-reconciling.title: Reconciling membership
leave-reconciling.lead: No duplicate leave is created while the exact result is checked.
leave-reconciling.notice: Observed membership truth decides the next route.

left-group.title: You left Zurich Weekend
left-group.lead: Future group access is removed for this account; historical attribution and ledger facts remain.
left-group.notice: Back must not re-expose the group after verified leave.

delete-review.title: Deletion has strict prerequisites
delete-review.lead: This effect removes the archived group workspace from this ChopDot working state only.
delete-review.notice: Deletion is not settlement, member removal, provider cleanup, or universal erasure.

delete-blocked-active-members.title: Other active members remain
delete-blocked-active-members.lead: J26 cannot remove people as a side effect of delete.
delete-blocked-active-members.notice: Manage membership through Journey 09, then re-check deletion prerequisites.

delete-blocked-open-items.title: Open items remain
delete-blocked-open-items.lead: Deleting the workspace cannot erase unresolved money or issue truth.
delete-blocked-open-items.notice: Resolve through the owning money/issue journey, then re-check current group truth.

delete-type-confirm.title: Type “Zurich Weekend”
delete-type-confirm.lead: The exact group name is required before the separate final review.
delete-type-confirm.notice: Typing the name does not delete anything; the first effect is still one screen away.

delete-mismatch.title: Deletion is still locked
delete-mismatch.lead: The typed value did not exactly match Zurich Weekend.
delete-mismatch.notice: Return and type the exact group name if you still intend to continue.

delete-final-review.title: Delete Zurich Weekend from this ChopDot state?
delete-final-review.lead: This is the last screen before the irreversible in-product delete effect.
delete-final-review.notice: After verified success the group will no longer be available in this working state.

deleting.title: Deleting the group workspace
deleting.lead: The stable delete operation is in flight; duplicate delete is disabled.
deleting.notice: Unknown result must reconcile before retry or before the UI claims the group is gone.

delete-cancelled.title: Deletion cancelled
delete-cancelled.lead: You cancelled before the delete effect.
delete-cancelled.notice: The group remains archived. Cancelled is not success.

delete-failed.title: The archived group still exists
delete-failed.notice: Because no effect is verified, safe retry can reuse the logical operation.

delete-unknown.title: Do not delete again yet
delete-unknown.lead: The UI cannot prove whether DEL26-A removed the group workspace.
delete-unknown.notice: Reconcile the exact delete operation first.

delete-reconciling.title: Reconciling deletion
delete-reconciling.lead: No duplicate delete is created while group-presence truth is checked.
delete-reconciling.notice: Observed effect/no-effect truth decides the next action.

delete-no-effect-retry.title: DEL26-A had no effect
delete-no-effect-retry.lead: The archived group is observed intact, so the same logical delete may retry.
delete-no-effect-retry.notice: A retry still does not widen the deletion scope.

deleted.title: Zurich Weekend was deleted here
deleted.lead: The group workspace is gone from this ChopDot working state.
deleted.notice: Back must not reconstruct or re-expose the deleted group from stale fixture state.

group-home-boundary.title: Group Home
group-home-boundary.lead: J26 enters from and returns to the approved Group Home context.
group-home-boundary.notice: Preview only: this card does not reimplement Journey 08 or mutate group facts.

manage-people-boundary.title: Manage People
manage-people-boundary.lead: Roster changes and member eligibility stay with the existing people journey.
manage-people-boundary.notice: Preview only: no person is added or removed here. Return with fresh group/member truth.

money-resolution-boundary.title: Resolve open items
money-resolution-boundary.lead: J26 cannot edit or forgive ledger facts to satisfy a lifecycle prerequisite.
money-resolution-boundary.notice: Preview only: no payment, settlement, signing or ledger mutation occurs here.

home-boundary.title: Home
home-boundary.lead: Verified leave/delete exits here because the current account no longer has that group workspace.
home-boundary.notice: Preview only: Home is not reimplemented in this candidate.

recovery-boundary.title: Recovery needed
recovery-boundary.lead: J26 reconciliation could not safely establish effect or no-effect for the exact lifecycle operation.
recovery-boundary.notice: Preview only: Journey 28 owns unresolved recovery. This boundary creates no new product authority.
